row.body: The furniture delivery sheet marks the appliances tested, but the installer’s key is returned before the power check is signed.
row.title: The appliance inventory

sidecar.gloss: Appliances are marked tested before the power check is signed.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency maintenance crew could test appliances during a power interruption; the sheet does not identify the cause.

row.body: the pocket calculator and first-aid kit carry the same black paint. a fresh scrape exposes an older evacuation color beneath.
row.title: missing count beside the pocket calculator

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
